cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Remember Me Correctly
cards.instruction: Create small tests of whether someone remembers your preferences, stories, or shared history.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before you take the tea through, which cup is mine?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can you just take one? Everyone's waiting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Twelve years of breakfast together. Which one have I always used?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The blue one. Your name's underneath.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Correct, but turn it upright. How much milk? I haven't written that on the handle.

mechanism: A copies a confident question-reading format without understanding the activity, then uses it to test remembered preferences.
confusable: D83 tests memory; D81 asks acknowledgment of importance without necessarily testing recall.
comparison: Breakfast preference test versus shared holiday quotation test.
seedUse: Keep cheating via written cup name provoking an unlabelled follow-up.
